Filter.BlockSummary: Set filters to be usedin several Analytics widgets and/or Analytics report blocks on the page.

Announcements.Summary: Display central announcements targeted at the logged-in user.

QuickLinks.Summary: Use this to display shared links created in Omnia admin, either for the tenant or for a business profile.

TaskRollup.Summary: Lists tasks from team sites, assigned to the logged-in user. Tasks from Planner may also be displayed.

NotificationPanel.Summary: Use this to display a notification panel set up in Omnia admin.

TrelloCards.Summary: Use this to configure aTrello list to display cards from.

Search.Summary: This block can be usedfor quick search or advanced search.

Form.Summary: Make a form available for users. These forms are created and maintained in Omnia admin.

FormQuestion.Summary: Used only when working with the graphic presentation of a form, in Omnia admin.

FormRollup.Summary: List forms for various purposes, or display a number of forms to be used.

MicrosoftTeamChannelFeed.Summary: Display a Teams channel feed. Thefeed will be read-only.

PostsFeed.Summary: Enables posting conversation messages in an app. Can also aggregate messages from several sources.

Properties.Title: Properties
Properties.Summary: Use this block to display information from a property.

PowerAppBlock.BlockSummary: Enables the addition of an app built according to Microsoft’s Power App framework.

OrgTreeBlock.BlockSummary: Display an organisation tree basedon information in Entra ID about who reports to whom.

QrCode.Summary: Usethis to place a QR code on any Omnia page.

SignOffRequest.BlockSummary: Can be used for various purposes regarding sign-off requests for pages and/or for controlled documents.

TaxonomyNavigation.BlockSummary: Create taxonomy-based navigation. A common example is an organisation chart.

UserInformation.BlockSummary: Use this to display user information, for example on a custom user profile card.

WebPart.WebPartSummary: Display the user profile progress as a percentage. Intended to be used with the new settings for user types.

Yammer.Summary: A Viva Engage feed can be displayed in this block.

GovernanceDashboard.BlockSummary: Display statistics about teamwork, search, pages, user activity, broken links or failed access attempts.

TeamNewsRollup.Summary: List team news for the logged-in user.

TeamCollaborationRollup.Summary: List team sites and other teamworkthe logged-in user has access to.

CreateApp.Summary: Enables the creationof an Omnia app; Publishing, Community or Teamwork.

People.BlockSummary: List people for many different purposes, with various views, filters and refiners.

WebPart.WebPartSummary: Display how far the logged-in user has progressed towards completing the profile, if using the older functionality.
